decision.intent: Decide whether the recorded screening run cleared the counterparty or matched it.
decision.question: Did the sanctions screening run come back clear for this counterparty?

evidenceRequirements.description: The screening run's recorded result for this counterparty.

outcomes.label: Clear
outcomes.description: The screening run recorded no match.

rules.description: Clear the counterparty when the recorded match count is exactly zero.
rules.rationale: A missing match count is not a clean screening; escalating is preferred to guessing.

rules.description: Return hit for the synthetic value two.
rules.rationale: An exact numeric equality exercises explicit JSON-number conversion.

escalation.message: Escalate a screening whose match count or record cannot be established.
